assets.name: canopy-complete
assets.prompt: EDIT the attached cut-paper canopy asset into a complete, naturally outlined freestanding canopy arch. Preserve its handmade matte paper style, muted sage/olive/deep navy/ochre lobed leaves, honey-brown curved branching wood, cream leaf veins, and the two navy lanterns with warm yellow centers, one on each side. Critical correction: the original artwork is abruptly cropped along the top and side edges. REDRAW / EXPAND THE COMPOSITION so ALL leaves and branches have complete organic outer contours within the canvas. Leave at least 8 percent genuinely transparent empty padding above the highest leaf, and around 5 percent padding at the left and right outermost leaves. NO shape may intersect the top or side image edge. Branch tips and thicker branch ends must end naturally behind leaf clusters rather than abruptly at a rectangular canvas boundary. Arrange the two sides into an airy low wide canopy arch, overall landscape ratio approximately 2:1. Keep the bottom-center open and transparent, suitable for people standing underneath in a layered woodland webpage. Preserve the two lanterns, paper grain, subtle paper-overlap shadows, and large flat cut shapes. No white or colored rectangular background, no ground, no whole forest or distant scenery, no text, no people, no bears, no border, no realistic gradients, no glow haze. Genuine transparent alpha all around and through the central opening. The complete natural upper leafy silhouette is the highest priority.
